content: Ye Sɑlomɔɔ u sɑ̃ɑ yee ten sɔmburu kuɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ u sii ɡeesu kɑ wurɑ kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ ni win tundo u rɑɑ yi sɑ̃ɑ yee ten sɔ̃ kpuro ɡurɑmɑ u doke Yinni Gusunɔn ɑrumɑnin beru yerɔ.
Bɑ woodɑn kpɑkororu yi Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ

Yen biru, Sɑlomɔɔ u Isirelibɑn ɡuro ɡurobu kɑ ben yɛnu yɛ̃robu kɑ bwese kɛrɑ bɑɑyeren wiruɡibu sokusiɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ bu kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkororu suɑmɑ sɑɑ Dɑfidin sinɑ kpɑɑrun di te bɑ mɑɑ mɔ̀ Siɔni, kpɑ bu tu doke sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi.
Yerɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ mɛnnɑ Sɑlomɔɔn mi wɔ̃ɔn suru nɔɔbɑ yiruse wì sɔɔ bɑ rɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru ɡɑru ko.
Ye ben ɡuro ɡuro be kpuro bɑ tunumɑ, yerɑ Lefibɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te suɑ,
kɑ win kuu bekuruɡii te, kɑ sere sɑ̃ɑrun dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni nu wɑ̃ɑ te sɔɔ kpuro. Yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑrɑ bɑ ye kpuro suɑmɑ.
Sinɑ boko Sɑlomɔɔ kɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro be bɑ mɛnnɛ mi, bɑ nɑ bɑ yɔ̃rɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro ten wuswɑɑɔ. Mɑ bɑ yɑ̃ɑnu kɑ kɛtɛ dɑbinu ɡo bɑ kɑ yɑ̃kunu kuɑ. Sɑbe ni bɑ ɡo mi, nu ǹ ɡɑrirɔ.
Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te dɑ ten ɑyerɔ dii te tɑ dɛɛre ɡem ɡem sɔɔ. Bɑ tu yiwɑ wɔllun kɔ̃sobun weenɑsibu yirun kɑsin kɔkɔrɔ.
Kɔ̃so be, bɑ kɑsɑ dɛriewɑ bɑ woodɑn kpɑkoro te kɑ ten nɛnutii wukiri.
Bɑ koo kpĩ bu nɛnutii yi wɑ yi tere sɑɑ dii te tɑ dɛɛre ɡem ɡem kɔnnɔn di. Domi bɑ yi kuɑwɑ yi dɛ̃u. Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu yi wɑ sɑɑ tɔɔn di. Miyɑ kpɑkoro te, tɑ wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ ɡisɔn ɡisɔ.
Gɑ̃ɑnu sɑri kpɑkoro te sɔɔ, mɑ n kun mɔ woodɑ wɔkurun kpee bɛsi yiru ye Mɔwisi u doke mi. Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u nùn yi wɛ̃ Horɛbun ɡuurɔ sɑnɑm mɛ u kɑ Isirelibɑ ɑrukɑwɑni bɔkuɑ ye bɑ yɑrimɑ Eɡibitin di.
Yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ tii dɛɛrɑsiɑ. Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ kue nɡe mɛ woodɑ yɑ nɛɛ bu ko wuuru kɑ wuuru. Mɑ be kpuro bɑ yɑrɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten min di.

Mɑ Lefibɑ kpuro be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ wom kowobu, Asɑfu kɑ Hemɑni kɑ Yedutum kɑ ben bibu kɑ beɡibu kpuro bɑ yɑbenu sebuɑ ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ wɛ̃ɛ dɑmɡii bɑ kɑ yɔ̃ yɑ̃ku yerun sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ bɑ sɛkɛtirɛnu nɛni kɑ ɡuunu kɑ mɔrɔkunu. Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu wunɑɑ teeru bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ben bɔkuɔ bɑ kɔbi soomɔ.

Be bɑ kɔbi soomɔ kɑ be bɑ womusu mɔ̀ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ siɑrɑmɔ bɑ mɔ̀, i Yinni Gusunɔ siɑro, domi u sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔn ɡeo, win durom mu ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ. Ye bɑ mɔ̀ mɛ, sɑɑ yerɑ ɡuru wii wurorɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yee te wukiri.
Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ kpɑnɑ bu yɔ̃rɑ bu ben sɔmburu ko ɡuru wii ten sɔ̃. Domi Yinni Gusunɔn yiikon ɡirimɑ yɑ dii te yibɑ.
